put.summary: Update which of the caller collections contain a place. Returns 403 when a collection is not owned by the caller.

get.summary: Read a collection. Returns 403 when the collection is private and the caller is not the owner.

patch.summary: Update a collection. Returns 403 when the caller does not own it.

delete.summary: Delete a collection. Returns 403 when the caller does not own it.

post.summary: Copy a public collection. Returns 403 when the collection is not public.

put.summary: Rate a public collection. Returns 403 when the collection is not public.
